      {key:'name',label:'Name'},{key:'symbol',label:'Ticker'},{key:'expected_return_pct',label:'Expected Return',format:pct},{key:'standard_deviation_pct',label:'Std Dev',format:pct},{key:'sharpe_ratio',label:'Sharpe Ratio',format:ratio}
    ]);

    // 5/15. Correlation matrices: add Name + Ticker as row identity; columns remain compact ticker/portfolio labels.
    const corrRows=records('correlations');
    const renderCorrelation=(id,names)=>{const slot=tableSlot(id);if(!slot||!corrRows.length)return;const by=new Map(corrRows.map(r=>[String(r.series),r]));const corrColor=v=>{if(!finite(v))return'transparent';const x=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,Number(v))),a=.10+Math.abs(x)*.55;return x<0?`rgba(225,29,72,${a})`:`rgba(37,99,235,${a})`;};slot.innerHTML=`<div class="feedback-table-note">Blue = positive correlation, red = negative correlation. Darker cells indicate stronger absolute correlation.</div><table class="heatmap feedback-table"><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Ticker</th>${names.map(n=>`<th>${esc(n==='provided'?'Provided':n==='optimized'?optimizedLabel:n==='benchmark'?benchmarkLabel:n)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${names.map(rowName=>{const row=by.get(rowName)||{};const isAsset=assetByTicker.has(rowName);const displayName=isAsset?assetName(rowName):(rowName==='provided'?'Provided Portfolio':rowName==='optimized'?optimizedLabel:rowName==='benchmark'?benchmarkLabel:'');const ticker=isAsset?rowName:(rowName==='benchmark'?(data.benchmark_symbol||'Benchmark'):'');return `<tr><td class="correlation-name">${esc(displayName)}</td><td>${esc(ticker)}</td>${names.map(col=>`<td style="background:${corrColor(row[col])}">${finite(row[col])?Number(row[col]).toFixed(2):'N/A'}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`}).join('')}</tbody></table>`;};
    const assetTickers=[...assetByTicker.keys()]; renderCorrelation('asset-correlations',assetTickers); renderCorrelation('portfolio-asset-correlations',[...assetTickers,'provided','optimized','benchmark'].filter(n=>corrRows.some(r=>String(r.series)===n)));

    // 6. Efficient Frontier: scale only to the frontier curve; off-curve asset dots are omitted and listed below.
    const renderFrontier=()=>{
      const root=chart('efficient-frontier'), points=(data.efficient_frontier||[]).filter(p=>finite(p.volatility_pct)&&finite(p.expected_return_pct)).slice().sort((a,b)=>Number(a.volatility_pct)-Number(b.volatility_pct)); if(!root||!points.length)return;
      const xs=points.map(p=>Number(p.volatility_pct)), ys=points.map(p=>Number(p.expected_return_pct)); let minX=Math.min(...xs),maxX=Math.max(...xs),minY=Math.min(...ys),maxY=Math.max(...ys); const xPad=(maxX-minX)*.025||.1,yPad=(maxY-minY)*.04||.1; minX-=xPad;maxX+=xPad;minY-=yPad;maxY+=yPad;
      const width=1000,height=330,left=66,right=28,top=18,bottom=52,x=v=>left+(v-minX)*(width-left-right)/(maxX-minX||1),y=v=>top+(maxY-v)*(height-top-bottom)/(maxY-minY||1),svg=svgEl('svg',{viewBox:`0 0 ${width} ${height}`});
      frame(svg,{width,height,left,right,top,bottom,xTicks:niceTicks(minX,maxX,5).map(v=>({value:v,label:`${v.toFixed(1)}%`})),yTicks:niceTicks(minY,maxY,5),xScale:x,yScale:y,yFmt:v=>`${v.toFixed(1)}%`,xTitle:'Standard Deviation %',yTitle:'Expected Return %'});
      svg.appendChild(svgEl('polyline',{points:points.map(p=>`${x(Number(p.volatility_pct))},${y(Number(p.expected_return_pct))}`).join(' '),fill:'none',stroke:BLUE,'stroke-width':3}));
      const curvePoints=points.map(p=>`${x(Number(p.volatility_pct))},${y(Number(p.expected_return_pct))}`).join(' ');
      const curveHit=svgEl('polyline',{points:curvePoints,fill:'none',stroke:'transparent','stroke-width':18,'pointer-events':'stroke'}); curveHit.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const rect=svg.getBoundingClientRect(),px=(e.clientX-rect.left)*width/rect.width,vol=minX+(px-left)/(width-left-right)*(maxX-minX),nearest=points.reduce((best,p)=>Math.abs(Number(p.volatility_pct)-vol)<Math.abs(Number(best.volatility_pct)-vol)?p:best,points[0]);showTip(e,`<b>Efficient Frontier</b><br>Expected Return: ${pct(nearest.expected_return_pct)}<br>Standard Deviation: ${pct(nearest.volatility_pct)}<br>Sharpe Ratio: ${ratio(nearest.sharpe_ratio)}<br><br>${Object.entries(nearest.weights_pct||{}).map(([t,w])=>`${esc(assetName(t))} (${esc(t)}): ${pct(w)}`).join('<br>')}`)}); curveHit.addEventListener('mouseleave',hideTip); svg.appendChild(curveHit);
      const hidden=[];
      frontierAssets.forEach(a=>{const ax=Number(a.standard_deviation_pct),ay=Number(a.expected_return_pct);if(ax<minX||ax>maxX||ay<minY||ay>maxY){hidden.push(a);return;}const c=svgEl('circle',{cx:x(ax),cy:y(ay),r:4.5,fill:GRAY});c.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>showTip(e,`<b>${esc(a.name)} (${esc(a.symbol)})</b><br>Expected Return: ${pct(ay)}<br>Std Dev: ${pct(ax)}<br>Sharpe Ratio: ${ratio(a.sharpe_ratio)}`));c.addEventListener('mouseleave',hideTip);svg.appendChild(c);});
      (data.frontier_landmarks||[]).forEach(l=>{const lx=Number(l.volatility_pct),ly=Number(l.expected_return_pct);if(lx<minX||lx>maxX||ly<minY||ly>maxY)return;const c=svgEl('circle',{cx:x(lx),cy:y(ly),r:5.5,fill:RED});c.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>showTip(e,`<b>${esc(l.label)}</b><br>Expected Return: ${pct(ly)}<br>Std Dev: ${pct(lx)}<br>Sharpe Ratio: ${ratio(l.sharpe_ratio)}${Object.keys(l.weights_pct||{}).length?'<br><br>'+Object.entries(l.weights_pct).map(([t,w])=>`${esc(assetName(t))} (${esc(t)}): ${pct(w)}`).join('<br>'):''}`));c.addEventListener('mouseleave',hideTip);svg.appendChild(c);});
      section('efficient-frontier')?.querySelectorAll('.legend').forEach(n=>n.remove());root.innerHTML='';root.appendChild(svg);const legend=document.createElement('div');legend.className='legend';legend.innerHTML=`<span style="--color:${BLUE}">Efficient Frontier</span><span style="--color:${GRAY}">Visible Assets</span><span style="--color:${RED}">Portfolio / Benchmark</span>`;root.before(legend);
      section('efficient-frontier')?.querySelector('.frontier-hidden')?.remove(); if(hidden.length){const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='frontier-hidden table-slot';wrap.innerHTML='<h3>Assets outside chart scale</h3>';section('efficient-frontier').appendChild(wrap);const tmp=document.createElement('div');wrap.appendChild(tmp);tmp.innerHTML=`<table class="feedback-table"><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Ticker</th><th>Std Dev</th><th>Expected Return</th><th>Sharpe Ratio</th></tr></thead><tbody>${hidden.map(a=>`<tr><td>${esc(a.name)}</td><td>${esc(a.symbol)}</td><td>${pct(a.standard_deviation_pct)}</td><td>${pct(a.expected_return_pct)}</td><td>${ratio(a.sharpe_ratio)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`;}
    };
    renderFrontier();

    // 7. Transition title + portfolio table with allocation columns first and ex-ante metrics at far right.
    if(period){const h=section('frontier-transition')?.querySelector('h2');if(h)h.textContent=`Efficient Frontier Transition Map (${period})`;}
    const frontierRows=records('efficient_frontier'), weightKeys=frontierRows.length?Object.keys(frontierRows[0]).filter(k=>k.startsWith('weight_')&&k.endsWith('_pct')):[];
    const rfMeta=configMeta.risk_free||{};
    const rfNote=rfMeta.requested_mode==='us_3m_tbill'
      ? 'Annualized ex-ante values shown for portfolio return and volatility. Ex-ante Sharpe Ratio calculated using historical U.S. 3-Month Treasury Bill Rate returns as the risk-free rate.'
      : finite(effectiveRfPct)
        ? `Annualized ex-ante values shown for portfolio return and volatility. Ex-ante Sharpe Ratio calculated using a fixed annual risk-free rate of ${pct(effectiveRfPct)}.`
        : 'Annualized ex-ante values shown for portfolio return and volatility.';
    renderTable('frontier-portfolios',frontierRows,[{key:'point',label:'Point'},...weightKeys.map(k=>({key:k,label:k.slice(7,-4),format:pct})),{key:'expected_return_pct',label:'Expected Return',format:pct},{key:'volatility_pct',label:'Standard Deviation',format:pct},{key:'sharpe',label:'Sharpe Ratio',format:ratio}],rfNote);

    // 9/10/12/18/19. Add readable percentage/date axes to time-series charts.
    const enhanceTimeSeriesAxes=(id,rows,valueKeys,yTitle)=>{const host=chart(id);if(!host||!rows.length)return;const svgs=[...host.querySelectorAll('svg')];const panels=svgs.length>1?svgs:[host.querySelector('svg')].filter(Boolean);panels.forEach((svg,panelIndex)=>{const panelRows=svgs.length>1?(panelIndex===0?(id==='active-return-contribution'?data.active_return_contribution_provided:data.rolling_active_provided):(id==='active-return-contribution'?data.active_return_contribution_optimized:data.rolling_active_optimized)):rows;if(!panelRows?.length)return;svg.querySelectorAll('.feedback-axis').forEach(n=>n.remove());const width=1000,height=Number(svg.getAttribute('viewBox')?.split(' ')[3])||260,margin=(id==='active-return-contribution'||id==='rolling-active-return')?42:34,left=margin,right=margin,top=margin,bottom=margin;const vals=panelRows.flatMap(r=>valueKeys.map(k=>num(r[k])).filter(v=>v!==null));if(id==='active-return-contribution'){const tickers=[...new Set(panelRows.flatMap(r=>Object.keys(r.contributions_pct||{})))];vals.splice(0,vals.length,...panelRows.flatMap(r=>tickers.map(t=>num(r.contributions_pct?.[t])).filter(v=>v!==null)));}if(!vals.length)return;const min=Math.min(...vals),max=Math.max(...vals),y=v=>height-bottom-(v-min)*(height-top-bottom)/(max-min||1);niceTicks(min,max,5).forEach(v=>{const yy=y(v),g=svgEl('g',{class:'feedback-axis'});g.appendChild(svgEl('line',{x1:left,y1:yy,x2:width-right,y2:yy,stroke:'#e5eaf2'}));g.appendChild(svgEl('text',{x:left-6,y:yy+3,'text-anchor':'end',class:'chart-tick'},`${v.toFixed(Math.abs(v)<10?1:0)}%`));svg.appendChild(g);});const dates=panelRows.map(r=>String(r.date||'')).filter(Boolean),step=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(dates.length/7));dates.forEach((d,i)=>{if(i%step!==0&&i!==dates.length-1)return;const xx=left+i*(width-left-right)/Math.max(dates.length-1,1),g=svgEl('g',{class:'feedback-axis'});g.appendChild(svgEl('text',{x:xx,y:height-bottom+17,'text-anchor':'middle',class:'chart-tick'},monthYear(d)));svg.appendChild(g);});if(id==='drawdown-chart'||id==='rolling-returns-3y'||id==='rolling-returns-5y'){const g=svgEl('g',{class:'feedback-axis'});g.appendChild(svgEl('text',{x:14,y:(top+height-bottom)/2,transform:`rotate(-90 14 ${(top+height-bottom)/2})`,'text-anchor':'middle',class:'chart-axis-label'},yTitle));g.appendChild(svgEl('text',{x:(left+width-right)/2,y:height-4,'text-anchor':'middle',class:'chart-axis-label'},'Month / Year'));svg.appendChild(g);}});};
    enhanceTimeSeriesAxes('active-return-contribution',data.active_return_contribution_provided||[],[],'Cumulative Active Return %');
    const contributionTable=tableSlot('active-return-contribution');if(contributionTable)contributionTable.remove();
